name: rosetta-old-russian-measure-of-length
code:
use default

use UNIT = (name: string, metres: double)

let units: UNIT[] = [
    (name = "tochka", metres = 0.00254),
    (name = "liniya", metres = 0.0254),
    (name = "dyuim", metres = 0.0254),
    (name = "vershok", metres = 0.04445),
    (name = "piad", metres = 0.1778),
    (name = "fut", metres = 0.3048),
    (name = "arshin", metres = 0.7112),
    (name = "sazhen", metres = 2.1336),
    (name = "versta", metres = 1066.8),
    (name = "milia", metres = 7467.6),
    (name = "centimeter", metres = 0.01),
    (name = "meter", metres = 1.0),
    (name = "kilometer", metres = 1000.0)
]

convert(amount: double, from: string) is
    let source = (units |> find(unit => unit.name =~ from))!

    write_line("{amount} {from} is")

    for unit in units do
        let converted = amount * source.metres / unit.metres

        write_line("  {converted,14:F6} {unit.name}")
    od

    write_line("")
si

convert(1.0, "arshin")
convert(2.0, "versta")
convert(1000.0, "meter")
